module_group_description: Enable or disable bot modules for this server.
module_enable_description: Enable a module for this server.
module_disable_description: Disable a module for this server.
module_list_description: List all configured modules for this server.
joke_add_description: Add a joke to the database for this server.
joke_remove_description: Remove a joke from the database by its ID.
joke_list_description: List jokes for this server (optionally filtered by category).
joke_id_description: ID of the joke to remove.
response_group_description: Manage auto-responder triggers for this server.
response_list_description: List all auto-responder triggers for this server.
response_trigger_description: The trigger phrase (message content to match).
response_text_description: The response text the bot will send.
cooldown_group_description: Configure cooldown limits for features on this server.
cooldown_set_description: Set a cooldown limit for a feature.
cooldown_list_description: List cooldown rules configured for this server.
cooldown_limit_name_description: Descriptive name for this limit (e.g. '15 minute limit').
cooldown_limit_count_description: Maximum uses allowed within the period.
cooldown_dm_threshold_description: Warning level at which a DM is sent (optional).
